text.content:
From cheap knock-offs to the sharpest smart guns.

Headquarters: A skyscraper in the Corporate Plaza (regional HQ)
Industry: Weapons, above all smart weapons
In Night City: A rising rival to Arasaka's arms business

Kang Tao used to be known for copies of other people's guns. It came out of the Time of the Red as an innovator in smart weapon technology, and its guns now rival Arasaka's for quality and reputation.

Gig hooks

  • A crate of prototype smart rifles fell off a truck in Arroyo. Kang Tao wants it back quietly; so does someone else.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.23
